signature: SUBROUTINE DORGHR( N, ILO, IHI, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix Q. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` must have the same values as in the previous call of DGEHRD. Q is equal to the unit matrix except in the submatrix Q(ilo+1:ihi,ilo+1:ihi). $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \mathrm{IHI} \le N$, if $N > 0$; `ILO=1` and `IHI=0`, if $N=0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the vectors which define the elementary reflectors, as returned by DGEHRD. On exit, the N-by-N orthogonal matrix Q.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by DGEHRD.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \mathrm{IHI}-\mathrm{ILO}$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge (\mathrm{IHI}-\mathrm{ILO}) \, \mathrm{NB}$, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.js: ihi < min( ilo, N ) || ihi > N
